label: Tulip Shape Patch
description: The tulip-shaped patch chest pocket is a design flourish in which the two upper corners of the pocket flare outward in gentle curves before turning down, evoking the silhouette of an open tulip bloom. It is an uncommon, high-individuality choice found primarily in the portfolios of creative Neapolitan and Florentine tailors who wish to give a jacket a distinctive artisanal signature. The organic form softens the jacket's front considerably and works best on fluid, unlined jackets where the pocket can be cut with relaxed, almost sculptural freedom.
